The regional pipelines retain source-specific time scales and age definitions
while applying the common training-period, model, and P-score contracts.

## Europe

The European analysis uses weekly Eurostat deaths by geography, age, and sex.
The canonical snapshot covers 2000-W01 through 2024-W19. Source-specific model
code is in [`code/regions/europe`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/tree/main/code/regions/europe),
and the production entry point is
[`scripts/model_fitting/europe/refit_eurostat.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/scripts/model_fitting/europe/refit_eurostat.R).

## England and Wales

The England-and-Wales analysis combines daily deaths by occurrence through 2020
with weekly registered deaths for 2021--2023. These two source definitions are
recorded explicitly in the data contract. The fitted analysis uses weekly age
groups `UNDER65`, `65-84`, and `GE85`.

The production entry point is
[`scripts/model_fitting/england_wales/refit.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/scripts/model_fitting/england_wales/refit.R).

## Ireland

The Ireland analysis uses quarterly registered deaths from CSO PxStat table
`VSQ20`, with age groups `25-44`, `45-64`, `65-84`, and `GE85`. The production
entry point is
[`scripts/model_fitting/ireland/refit.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/scripts/model_fitting/ireland/refit.R).

## Canada

The Canadian analysis uses weekly provisional deaths from Statistics Canada
Table `13-10-0768-01`, stratified by province or territory, age, and sex. The
production entry point is
[`scripts/model_fitting/canada/refit.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/scripts/model_fitting/canada/refit.R).

## United States

The United States analysis uses monthly CDC WONDER exports grouped by residence
state and age, with a separate sex-stratified export. Calendar days per month
enter the fitted model as an offset. The target graph is defined in
[`_targets.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/_targets.R),
and the production runner is
[`scripts/pipeline/run_pipeline.R`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/scripts/pipeline/run_pipeline.R).

## Common outputs

Each pipeline writes standardized summaries below the ignored `output/`
directory. The reporting scripts then construct the manuscript figures and
tables from those summaries. No regional model is fitted when this website is
built.
